hypothesis: At the same 120-record fit and 60-record calibration support used by r28, the 64x64x101 Factorized FNO will escape the zero-output floor and reduce train-only calibration relative L2 below 0.8 within 20 epochs.
literature_basis: Factorized Fourier operators separate spatial spectral mixing from temporal evolution and directly address the low-spatial-mode phase error identified by the project capacity study.
expected_mechanism: Global 2D spectral convolutions share medium-dependent propagation patterns across records, while the temporal mixer learns waveform transport without requiring independent per-pixel Fourier coefficients.
primary_metric: best low-resolution train-only calibration relative L2
failure_signal: Failure to beat 0.98 after epoch 5, non-finite prediction, OOM, missing checkpoint, or calibration above 0.8 rejects the low-resolution Factorized FNO pilot without opening confirmation or project validation/test_id.
rollback: Preserve r31 smoke and all prior artifacts; if rejected, return to train-only architecture diagnostics without opening confirmation or project validation/test_id.
